title: Camera health monitor with fault detection and recovery logic
description: Implement camera/camera_health.py to monitor camera read latency, detect frozen feeds, handle camera disconnections, and manage automatic recovery and status reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects frame read timeouts (e.g. no new frame for > 2.0s) and flags Camera Fault state
Emits camera health status events: Ready, Active, Warning, Fault, Disconnected
Implements retry and auto-reconnect backoff mechanism
Unit tests verify fault detection upon missed frames and successful recovery upon reconnection

steps.details: Create camera/camera_health.py tracking last_frame_time, frame_count, fps, and connection state.
Implement check_health() method called on each frame or timer, detecting read failures and setting status to CAMERA_FAULT.
Implement attempt_recovery() with exponential backoff and retry counter limits.

steps.description: Write unit tests for camera health monitor
steps.details: Create tests/test_camera_health.py testing active health, simulated timeout transition to fault, and recovery callback.

technicalNotes: Log camera health state transitions through EventLogger.
Keep health monitor decoupled from UI logic.
